singleton_reference.design: Fix the native physical seams and the blank reference rail. Apply the unit energy only to absolute written contrast one on missing-seam contacts. Preserve the native vacuum and binary reference energies and require occupation reflection.
gates: Check all nine blank-collar load columns directly in the native 99-state echo, including zero leakage and reference load two.
Prove identity with the native free Hamiltonian on every binary load configuration and reflection symmetry on the entire qutrit free space.
Replay all five sharp-release distributions at kappa eight. Require all 34 bins to match the original within 1e-9.
Repeat the common-background excess and vacancy read at every registered exposure and level. Require matched complete records equal to the native vacancy arm within 2e-11.
Test the predicted nonconstant doubled-load energy shift on mixed-degree carriers and report the loss of the native position generator up to scalar.
singleton_reference.scope: Experimental reference service. The centered-reference failure was known at design. Raw laboratory data do not enter this profile. Free propagation and isolated physical seam pulses only.

pair_regression.source: Use the M10.3 sharp release, complete carrier and terminal census in confinement_protocol.json.
pair_regression.gate: Report whether the local home-seam probability exceeds 0.8 at each exposure, and report its difference from the unchanged native law. These are fixed exposures, without a between-exposure criterion or hosted row claim.

ports: Least degree-six home port a, least degree-five home neighbor b, least home neighbor c of b distinct from a and b.
sequence: Starting at a single defect on a, apply isolated native half contacts ab then bc, free exposure, and a final half contact ab. Read the defect address among all twelve home ports or quiet. A fresh preparation supplies every exposure.
predictions: Compare full reduced generators inferred from native qutrit matrix elements with the exact complement formula for every board and both defect signs.

At a mixed-degree seam the two native xy-read slopes differ by kappa. A supplied unit reference at every missing seam restores occupation complement for the full free law. Exchange alone also gives equal records.
At exposure 1/16 the native nominated-port probabilities differ by more than 0.10 on the 20-cell board; report all other fixed levels and exposures including any failure.
scope: Test of the sitewise occupation-complement particle/antiparticle dictionary. The uniform medium, controller, local occupation read and prepared reference are supplied. The unit-reference law is a changed comparison, with no inherited physical row. The paired local interference design and analytic predictions were known before these runs. No empirical constants.
